Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Class CreativeEditor

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.creative.CreativeEditor
public final class CreativeEditor extends Object
A mutable view of a CreativeLayout. Not thread safe; obtain one from CreativeLayout.edit(), or receive one in a PaletteLayer creative edit.

Placement is relative to things that already exist, never by raw index, so edits keep working when a new Bedrock version shuffles the vanilla layout: 


 editor.insert(BedrockItemStack.of(BedrockItemType.of("geysermc:furnace_minecart"))).after(ItemMatcher.id("minecraft:hopper_minecart"));
 editor.groupOrCreate(CreativeCategory.ITEMS, "geyser:tools").add(stack).placeAfterGroup("itemGroup.name.minecart");
 editor.remove(ItemMatcher.id("minecraft:empty_map").and(ItemMatcher.damage(2)));
Placements that depend on an anchor return false when the anchor does not exist, so a fallback is a plain ||: insertion.after(anchor) || insertion.intoGroup(name).
Since:
1.0.0
